d:
The Mavericks defeated the Pacers, 125-122 tonight in Dallas. Cooper Flagg finished with a team-high 43 points along with 10 rebounds and 6 assists for the Mavericks, while Kyrie Irving tallied 35 points, 7 three pointers and 4 assists in the game. Pascal Siakam recorded 29 points, 9 rebounds and 8 assists. The Mavericks improve their record to 7-4 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 3-8 for the season.
